issues.failure_explanation: In an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck / linear SDE with drift matrix A, the covariance evolution is governed by the Lyapunov equation \dot\Sigma_t = A\Sigma_t + \Sigma_t A^T + 2\mathbf C_{*,t}. Here A = -(\gamma/\kappa)(I - (\beta/\kappa) P_t \mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1}). In the proof, the author omits the transpose on A in the second term, writing \Sigma_t A instead of \Sigma_t A^T. Because P_t and \mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1} do not commute in general when \Sigma_t and \Sigma do not commute, \Sigma_t P_t \mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1} \ne \Sigma_t \mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1} P_t$, and the right-hand side of equation (23b) is not even symmetric, violating the mandatory symmetry of \dot\Sigma_t.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace \Sigma_t P_t \mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1} by \Sigma_t \mathbf C_{*,t}^{-1} P_t in equation (23b) and in the proof of Lemma 4.
issues.overall_effect: Equation (23b) is incorrect for general Gaussian distributions when \Sigma_t and \Sigma do not commute, yielding an asymmetric matrix derivative for the covariance.
issues.title: Missing transpose in covariance ODE for Gaussian target
issues.why_classification: A routine one-line fix restores the correct Lyapunov equation. Downstream results (Corollary 5 and Lemma 7) evaluate either when \Sigma_t = \Sigma or when the matrices commute, so all substantive conclusions and guarantees survive intact without new lemmas or architecture.

issues.failure_explanation: Lemma 7 asserts equivalence for any \alpha > 0. However, the localized CBS preconditioner requires \lambda > 0; if \alpha \le \alpha', then \lambda = \alpha'/(\alpha - \alpha') \le 0 (undefined if \alpha = \alpha', and negative if \alpha < \alpha', which makes the weighting kernel exponentially divergent and the integrals ill-defined). Furthermore, the dynamics (20) depend on the free method parameter \gamma, which Lemma 7 fails to specify in its statement, even though the proof requires \gamma = 2\alpha'/(\alpha'+1). Finally, the proof contains an intermediate algebraic sign error that drops the minus sign before matching with equation (29).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the condition \alpha > \alpha' and specify \gamma = 2\alpha'/(\alpha'+1) in the statement of Lemma 7, and correct the intermediate sign error in the proof.
issues.overall_effect: The equivalence statement is undefined or false when \alpha \le \alpha', or when \gamma is not set to 2\alpha'/(\alpha'+1).
issues.title: Missing hypotheses on alpha and gamma in CBS equivalence lemma
issues.why_classification: Adding standard conditions (\alpha > \alpha' and fixing \gamma) fully preserves the claim that localized CBS can reproduce CBS dynamics for any CBS parameter \alpha' > 0, without requiring new proof architecture.
